items.what: BUG: WindowJourneys.lua:192 always labels the selected journey "shown", drifting from Panel.lua:1159 and the canonical chosen-card behavior in Overview.CardClick (Overview.lua:304-323).
items.why: WindowJourneys.lua:179-180 attaches the shared CardClick/CardTooltip handlers, but RefreshCard never sets "chosen" even when Refresh computes chosen=true at line 383. Panel supplies "chosen" for the active journey. Overview.CardClick uses that state to refocus an already-running journey without calling ns.Choose, or resume it when paused; "shown" instead calls ns.Choose(key, titleStartsRoute). With the default titleStartsRoute=true, Core.lua:712 and 791-792 restart guidance through StartRoute. A read-only stdin LuaJIT reproduction using tests/harness.lua, spf="v1+", completed={844}, and log quests 845 (complete) and 843 selected the route and then clicked its visible window card: route.chosen=true, card.state="shown", ns.Choose called once, and NavigateRoute increased 1 -> 2. Clicking the map panel chosen card immediately afterward left NavigateRoute at 2; the harness reported zero errors. The same state also makes the selected window card tooltip say CLICK_TO_CHOOSE. The window intentionally keeps the large-card layout, but that visual choice should not change the shared click/tooltip contract. Found while comparing the parallel map/window implementations; fixing this changes behavior and is not a cleanup-only edit.
items.reason: window cards take the chosen state for the chosen journey, as the map panel's do, so a second click never restarts guidance
